raw_response:

The company has a critically low current ratio of 0.34, with current liabilities of 1,775,239M vastly exceeding current assets of 612,094M, indicating an imminent liquidity crisis. Furthermore, total liabilities of 2,025,439M relative to total assets of 2,205,752M leave a razor-thin equity cushion (shareholders' equity of 178,396M), while the operating income (EBIT) of 5,851M is grossly insufficient to service this massive debt load.

DECISION: CCC
